features: Key Applications: Container-as-a-Service; Application Accelerator, Diskless HPC Clusters, All-Flash Hyperconverged Infrastructure
Key Features: Two hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:
Socket E (LGA 4677) support 4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors
Up to 16 DIMMs ECC DDR5 Slots
Internal PCIe 4.0 x8 for 2 M.2 NVMe support onboard
Optional M.2 NVMe Boot Controller via SCC-A2NM2241G3-B1
12 hot-swap 2.5" drive bays (2x PCIe 5.0 NVMe and 10x PCIe 4.0 NVMe/SAS) per node
Built-in SAS3 Support via Broadcom 3816; IT Mode
4 cooling fans per 2U enclosure, Heavy Duty, 16.5K RPM; Shared Cooling Design
2200W Redundant Power Supplies Titanium Level (96%+); Shared Power Design
